...but *Gukesh* surprised us by playing a SUPER RARE sideline called the **Rio de Janeiro variation of the Spanish**. ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ruy_Lopez#:~:text=There%20are%20also%20a%20number%20of%20sidelines%20that%20Black%20can%20also%20play%20which%20avoid%20the%20endgame.%20These%20include%205...Be7%2C%20the%20Rio%20de%20Janeiro%20Variation) says that it's a way to "avoid the endgame.") I've never heard of it... which, of course doesn't say much: I'm a schmuck. https://stacker.news/items/1598241

The tables were completely turned, with *Sindarov* massively down on the clock, Gukesh knowing everything and blitzing out moves (all the way up to move \~20-ish). ***Crazy***. Some excitement and weird positions in the middlegame, but it all fiddled out into an opposite-color bishop endgame.

...as always, chess is a draw if both players play perfectly. We got an accuracy score *even higher* than in Game 2
![](https://m.stacker.news/168638)

***

## playing chess in the 21st century:

"Wow, Gukesh is the first to deviate," said Peter Svidler on the livestream, genuinely surprised!

* "...as a surprise weapon for one game, it's *excellent*!"
* "similar in spirit to the Berlin, despite the queens remaining on"
* "Javokhir has the better version of this 0.00 position"

And **this is elite, high-level chess with long time controls.** You have two extremely well-prepared dudes (assisted by large teams of seconds and researchers) coming into a head-to-head 14-game match in *long af* time controls. Everybody knows everything, has studied every line more or less... to get an advantage and some winning chances, you *have to take some obscure paths*, often even objectively losing: going down a pawn, horrible and ugly structure. 

![](https://m.stacker.news/168639)

Yesterday, we *almost* got triple pawns... unfortunately, Sindarov didn't play Qxc4 to create that nice kebab-stack of pawns on the c-file, but instead just attacked the queen with a pawn (b3), overprotecting the knight. **You take meeee, bitch**... which Gukesh did in the game. 

*Interesting observation, also*: as black, you can't just take that free c pawn... and then *also* the b pawn after the queen is attacked by the rooks. Putting *that* position on the board, we get a +0.7 evaluation *even though black has just gobbled two pawns*. 

![](https://m.stacker.news/168640)

queen *doesn't get trapped*, it's just bad long-term/positional (*I guess*...?). And honestly, black just won't be able to defend those two doubled pawns on the c-file. 

***

Yeah, I wrote this playing the old-school "Samba" song on repeat.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fhHKYR-v0UE

items.title: Tether Fun Unbelievable Details - Part VII
items.text:
*This is part of a larger series on the history of Tether. Part I (*https://stacker.news/items/1042943*), Part II (*https://stacker.news/items/1059310*), Part III (*https://stacker.news/items/1115791*), Part IV (*https://stacker.news/items/1410689/*), Part V (*https://stacker.news/items/1613156*), Part VI (https://stacker.news/items/1617443)*

# 20 THE GENIUS ACT

20.1   The primary version of the GENIUS Act (Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for U.S. Stablecoins Act) of 2025 [is introduced](https://www.govtrack.us/congress/bills/119/s919/text/is) in the US Senate by Bill Hagerty, Cynthia Lummis, Kirsten Gillibrand, and Tim Scott on 10 March 2025.

20.11   Also on this day: "GM, back to Washington DC today" [-Paolo Ardoino](https://x.com/paoloardoino/status/1899074589868581364)

20.12   An earlier version of the bill was [first introduced](https://www.cov.com/en/news-and-insights/insights/2025/02/seven-things-to-know-about-the-federal-stablecoin-bill-the-genius-act) on 4 February 2025.

20.121   This was based on draft legislation Bill Hagerty [released](https://www.hagerty.senate.gov/press-releases/2024/10/10/hagerty-releases-discussion-draft-of-comprehensive-stablecoin-legislation/) on 10 October 2024.

20.122   "Stablecoins have the potential not only to enhance transactions and payment systems, but also to help create new demand for U.S. Treasuries as we work to address our unsustainable deficit," [said Senator Hagerty](https://www.hagerty.senate.gov/press-releases/2024/10/10/hagerty-releases-discussion-draft-of-comprehensive-stablecoin-legislation/). "For too long, these benefits and the broader promise of stablecoins have been hindered by the lack of clear regulations. My draft legislation provides much-needed clarity, putting in place the legal framework necessary to unlock this technology’s full potential for the benefit of Americans."

20.2   The month before, on 13 September 2024, Tether [announced](https://tether.io/news/industry-leader-jesse-spiro-joins-tether-as-head-of-government-affairs/) that they were hiring Jesse Spiro as Head of Government Affairs.

20.21   On 26 February 2025, Jesse Spiro [registers](https://lda.gov/filings/public/filing/6d351923-49fd-4662-b017-c3d9150a696f/print/) Jucundus Business Services LLC as a organization/lobbying firm lobbying on behalf Tether Holdings, S.A. de C.V. and Giancarlo Devasini, c/o SHRM Trustees BVI Limited

20.211   On a 21 April 2025 Lobbying Disclosure Act of 1995 Lobbying Report, Jesse Spiro [reports](https://lda.gov/filings/public/filing/582b5e28-638b-4083-abaf-dca18ce9b4a6/print/) $40,000 of lobbying income for Jucundus Business Services LLC specifying activity related to "legislative and regulatory policies related to cryptocurrency" and "S. 394, GENIUS Act of 2025" and "H.R. 2392, STABLE Act of 2025"

20.212   Jesse Spiro list his [contact email](https://lda.gov/filings/public/filing/582b5e28-638b-4083-abaf-dca18ce9b4a6/print/) as [jesse.spiro@tether.to](mailto:jesse.spiro@tether.to)

20.22   "I think that Genius Act is a step in the right direction." [-Paolo Ardoino on *Bankless*](https://banklesscom.beehiiv.com/p/the-stablecoin-king-tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino)

20.221   "it creates a strong framework for domestic stablecoins, as well as foreign stablecoins like USDT that could find in their ability to meet their requirements through comparable regimes." [-Paolo Ardoino on *Bankless*](https://banklesscom.beehiiv.com/p/the-stablecoin-king-tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino)

20.222   "the Genius Act creates a very, very high bar for everyone. That's the thing that I think I like the most, and it's very fair. In a sense that it creates a very high bar when it comes to AML and compliance. Yesterday, there was a huge news of Tether collaborating with the Department of Justice. Tether was able, with its own means, almost one year and a half ago at this point, to identify through its monitoring technology. We built, I think, the most amazing technology for monitoring our secondary markets in the blockchain ecosystem when it comes to stable coins and specific USDT. We were able to identify a big battery scheme and when we did that, we immediately notified the law enforcement, i.e. the DOJ, and they agreed with our analysis. We proceed to the freezing and now basically the DOJ is in the process of receiving this money and working on restitution." [-Paolo Ardoino on *Bankless*](https://banklesscom.beehiiv.com/p/the-stablecoin-king-tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino)

20.223   "We collaborated with more than 250 law enforcement agencies across more than 55 different countries." [-Paolo Ardoino on *Bankless*](https://banklesscom.beehiiv.com/p/the-stablecoin-king-tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino)

20.224   "Tether has in this moment as a group equity has around $176 billion in front of the $155 billion in market cap of the stable coin. And precisely, we keep just on top of the single reserves of the stablecoin, of the 100% of reserves of the USDT stablecoin, we keep around $6 billion in excess, right? Compared to the standard banking system that usually goes in fractional reserve up to 90%. So they keep only 10% of liquid assets. Tether has like 100 and something percent, like 105 percent of liquid assets as reserves of the stable coin. On top of that, we have another 15 billion dollars as a group equity to add." [-Paolo Ardoino on *Bankless*](https://banklesscom.beehiiv.com/p/the-stablecoin-king-tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino)

20.225   "Remember 2023 when you know our major competitor almost died because of Silicon Valley Bank and Silvergate signature, all targeted by the Operation Choke Point 2.0, but nevertheless almost killed our competitor." [-Paolo Ardoino on *Bankless*](https://banklesscom.beehiiv.com/p/the-stablecoin-king-tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino)

20.226   "But you know I just I just want to applaud the the efforts that have been done by by Senator Hagerty, Lummis and all the others David Sacks, Bo Hines." [-Paolo Ardoino on *Bankless*](https://banklesscom.beehiiv.com/p/the-stablecoin-king-tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino)

20.23   "I view our role, specifically my office, as being like an administrator and/or sherpa between White House policy, industry, interagency activity and what's happening on Capitol Hill" [-Bo Hines](https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2025-04-04-three-months-in-bo-hines-on-quarterbacking-the-white-houses-crypto-strategy-349632)

20.231   "We created them (a bitcoin reserve and crypto stockpile) separately for a reason and that reason is because bitcoin is unique. Bitcoin is the grandfather." [-Bo Hines](https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2025-04-04-three-months-in-bo-hines-on-quarterbacking-the-white-houses-crypto-strategy-349632)

20.232   In response to a Coindesk question about how much Bitcoin should be in the US Strategic Bitcoin Reserve, Bo Hines [says](https://cointelegraph.com/news/us-bitcoin-reserve-plans-continue-donald-trump-bo-hines) "As much as we can possibly get."

20.24   "In order for their stablecoins to trade among U.S. users, under the latest version, foreign stablecoin issuers will have their nation's regulatory regime assessed by the Treasury and other banking regulators for comparability with the U.S." [-Brady Dale, "Latest Senate stablecoin bill addresses foreign issuers, national security safeguards" *Axios*](https://archive.is/RqM1x)

20.241   "The Trump administration, for example, could strike a reciprocity agreement with the Bukele regime in El Salvador, where Tether is based, allowing Tether full access to the U.S. market while sidestepping the requirements of the bill." [-Democratic Staff of the Senate Banking Committee Outline Critical Ammendments to Fix *The GENIUS Act*](https://www.banking.senate.gov/imo/media/doc/genius_act_analysis_6925.pdf)

20.242   "Similarly, the OCC is not providing a safe harbor for foreign affiliates that operate under a comparable regime because these are determinations of the Department of the Treasury that have yet to be made." [-Federal Register](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-10-23/html/2026-21706.htm)

20.25   "Hines, who President Donald Trump hired as executive director of the Presidential Council of Advisers for Digital Assets, told CoinDesk in an interview that the procedures are being ironed out to move legislation on regulating stablecoin issuers, and the crypto advocates in the White House and Congress will quickly pivot to the bigger bill that will set a full regulatory regime for U.S. crypto markets." [-Jesse Hamilton, "Trump's Crypto Sherpa Bo Hines Says Crypto Legislation on Target for Quick Completion" *CoinDesk* 30 April 2025](https://web.archive.org/web/20250512151544/https://www.coindesk.com/consensus-toronto-2025-coverage/2025/04/30/trumps-crypto-sherpa-bo-hines-says-crypto-legislation-on-target-for-quick-completion)

20.251   "We view bitcoin as digital gold, and we want to accumulate as much as we can." [-Bo Hines](https://web.archive.org/web/20250512151544/https://www.coindesk.com/consensus-toronto-2025-coverage/2025/04/30/trumps-crypto-sherpa-bo-hines-says-crypto-legislation-on-target-for-quick-completion)

20.252   "The then-29-year-old White House aide, a North Carolina entrepreneur and crypto investor who ran unsuccessful congressional campaigns as a Republican in 2022 and 2024, became the administration’s self-described “bully” on the bill. As negotiations neared the finish line, Hines said that a provision Tether wanted was a “red line” for the White House, according to three other people familiar with the matter." [-Anthony Cormier, David Kocieniewski, and Annie Massa, "How Tether Benefited as Trump Insiders Shaped First US Crypto Law" *Bloomberg* 22 July 2026](https://archive.is/agHnj)

20.253   "In negotiations, he told people that Tether was important to the White House and Republicans should stand firm. Keeping the three-year grace period was a “red line,” Hines said, according to three people familiar with his conversations." [-Anthony Cormier, David Kocieniewski, and Annie Massa, "How Tether Benefited as Trump Insiders Shaped First US Crypto Law" *Bloomberg* 22 July 2026](https://archive.is/agHnj)

20.26   A 10 March 2025 version of the GENIUS Act requires that US digital-asset service providers only offer qualifying stablecoins (ie not USDT) within 18 months of the bill's passage, however by 1 May, this grace-period was extended to three years.

20.261   "In general.--Except as provided in subsection (c) and section 18, beginning on the date that is 3 years after the date of enactment of this Act, it shall be unlawful for any digital asset service provider to offer or sell a payment stablecoin to a person in the United States, unless the payment stablecoin is issued by a permitted payment stablecoin issuer." [-S. 1582 "A Bill To provide for the regulation and of payment stablecoins, and for other purposes"](https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/BILLS-119s1582pcs/html/BILLS-119s1582pcs.htm)

20.27   On 17 June 2025, The GENIUS Act (P.L. 119-27) [is passed](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/R49351.html#_Toc240544941) on a final vote of 68-30 by the Senate

20.28   On 17 July 2025, it [is passed](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/R49351.html#_Toc240544941) by the House 308-122 without amendment.

20.29   President Donald Trump [signs](https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefings-statements/2025/07/the-president-signed-into-law-s-1582/) the GENIUS Act into law on 18 July 2025.

20.3   "Where's Bo Hines?" [-Donald Trump, during the signing of the GENIUS Act](https://archive.is/nfiDU#selection-2513.69-2513.89)

20.31   22 December 2024 Trump [appoints](https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/statement-president-elect-donald-j-trump-announcing-science-and-technology-team) Bo Hines to be Executive Director of the Presidential Council of Advisers for Digital Assets.

20.311   "...Additionally, Bo Hines will be the Executive Director of the Presidential Council of Advisers for Digital Assets (the "Crypto Council"), a new advisory group composed of luminaries from the Crypto industry, and chaired by our Crypto Czar, David Sacks. Bo is a graduate of Yale University, and Wake Forest University Law School. In his new role, Bo will work with David to foster innovation and growth in the digital assets space, while ensuring industry leaders have the resources they need to succeed. Together, they will create an environment where this industry can flourish, and remain a cornerstone of our Nation's technological advancement." [-Donald Trump](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/113698639577293090)

20.312   Hines was a "two-time Republican congressional candidate, who had never held a formal business role in the tight-knit crypto sector" [-Jessica Matthews and Leo Schwartz, "Trump's senior crypto advisor donated $1M in campaign advertisements to top Trump super PAC one week before election" *Fortune* 14 April 2026](https://fortune.com/2025/04/14/trump-senior-crypto-advisor-donated-1m-campaign-advertisements-maga-super-pac-week-before-election/)

20.313   "Four years after he graduated from Yale, Hines ran for the House in a North Carolina district in the Raleigh area with an endorsement from Trump, making it to the general election before he lost in 2022." [-Jessica Matthews and Leo Schwartz, "Trump's senior crypto advisor donated $1M in campaign advertisements to top Trump super PAC one week before election" *Fortune* 14 April 2026](https://fortune.com/2025/04/14/trump-senior-crypto-advisor-donated-1m-campaign-advertisements-maga-super-pac-week-before-election/)

20.314   "Two years later, in 2024, he lost in the primary in a different district." [-Jessica Matthews and Leo Schwartz, "Trump's senior crypto advisor donated $1M in campaign advertisements to top Trump super PAC one week before election" *Fortune* 14 April 2026](https://fortune.com/2025/04/14/trump-senior-crypto-advisor-donated-1m-campaign-advertisements-maga-super-pac-week-before-election/)

20.32   "Prior to politics Hines played college football as a wide receiver for North Carolina State and Yale. He received a law degree from Wake Forest University in 2022, and is 29 years old." [-Unchained Crypto](https://unchainedcrypto.beehiiv.com/p/who-will-be-on-the-crypto-council)

20.321   "Hines became interested in crypto when he played football in the 2014 Bitcoin St. Petersburg Bowl for North Carolina State during his freshman year in college. He bought bitcoin shortly afterwards and became a "pretty avid trader." [-Sarah Wynn, "Three months in: Bo Hines on quarterbacking the White House's crypto strategy" *The Block*](https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2025-04-04-three-months-in-bo-hines-on-quarterbacking-the-white-houses-crypto-strategy-349632)

20.3211   "Today is camp report date! With that, I will be turning off social media until the seasons over! See you all at Carter-Finley! #timetowin" [Bo Hines, 29 September 2014](https://web.archive.org/web/20140929100236/https://twitter.com/BoHines)

20.322   "Bo plans to run for office in his home state of North Carolina shortly after graduating from law school." [https://web.archive.org/web/20180820182039/https://www.bohines.com/](https://web.archive.org/web/20180820182039/https://www.bohines.com/)

20.323   "After my freshman year, I transferred to Yale University to study political science and to learn more about government. I witnessed the legislative process first-hand as an intern on Capitol Hill and studied local issues as an intern for Lieutenant Governor Dan Forest." [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126180421/https://bo4nc.com/about](https://web.archive.org/web/20210126180421/https://bo4nc.com/about)

20.324   "I loved the school and staff and it was close to home," Hines said of N.C. State. "But ultimately I knew I wanted to have a political career and I felt like Yale would give me the best opportunity to do that one day." [-Desmond Conner, "Yale Wide Receiver Hines Finally Healthy" *The Courant* 14 August 2017](https://web.archive.org/web/20220101021214/https://www.courant.com/sports/college/hc-yale-football-bo-hines-feature-0815-20170814-story.html)

20.34   "Bo is a steadfast ally of the #crypto industry. During his visit to the @BlockchainAssn HQ earlier this year, we were impressed by his deep understanding of #crypto, #bitcoin & his commitment to fostering innovation." [-Dan Spuller](https://x.com/DanSpuller/status/1870971234080657687)

20.341   "Spuller told Unchained that Hines met with the Blockchain Association as a candidate for Congress in the primary this year, and that he did not know that he was being considered for a role on the Crypto Council." [-Unchained Crypto](https://unchainedcrypto.beehiiv.com/p/who-will-be-on-the-crypto-council)

20.35   "Mr. Hines entered government service in March of 2025 and filed his initial “new entrant” public financial disclosure report on June 24, 2025. Mr. Hines reported a single IRA, salary from his time with Today is America, LLC (which he reported ended in 2024), and an interest in Nxum Group, LLC, which was described as a media consulting group. Mr. Hines reported having a position with Nxum up until January 1, 2025. He also reported a financial interest in the fund valued at $25-$50 million. In an endnote, Mr. Hines disclosed that Nxum held four companies: Kiwi Bot; Intersect Technologies; Today is America, LLS; and Kapsul. Mr. Hines did not individualize the value or income derived from these underlying holdings." [-Democracy Defenders Fund, "RE: Request for Conflict of Interest Investigation into Bo Hines, Former Executive Director for Presidential Council of Advisors for Digital Assets" 9 November 2026](https://www.democracydefendersfund.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/110926_DDF_Bo-Hines.-Conflict-of-Interest-Request-for-Investigation-.pdf)

20.351   "Tether is by far and away the most important private public partnership the US government has. We're buying more treasuries than anyone else in the private sector. It makes us less reliant on foreign adversaries in order to purchase our debt." [Bo Hines](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-bloomberg-talks-116249773/episode/tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino-tether-usa-ceo-bo-hines-talk-stablecoin-294739882/)

20.4   "Hines says he translated his experience running for office into his work at Charlotte-based Nxum." [-Jessica Matthews and Leo Schwartz, "Trump's senior crypto advisor donated $1M in campaign advertisements to top Trump super PAC one week before election" *Fortune* 14 April 2026](https://fortune.com/2025/04/14/trump-senior-crypto-advisor-donated-1m-campaign-advertisements-maga-super-pac-week-before-election/)

20.41   NXUM's clients include [Kush Kriminals](https://web.archive.org/web/20230511004149/https://www.kushkriminals.com/), Today is America, and Kiwi Bot.

20.411   In 2020, Today is America's website [is mostly](https://web.archive.org/web/20201103235248/https://www.todayisamerica.com/) a clothing store.

20.4111   In 2021, Today is America's website [describes itself as](https://web.archive.org/web/20210924070123/https://www.todayisamerica.com/) "one of the fastest growing Gen-Z organizations in the country with over 200 content creators."

20.4112   Bo Hines is [not listed](https://web.archive.org/web/20210923212337/https://www.todayisamerica.com/about) on Today is America's about page in 2021.

20.4113   On 2 March 2023, Bo Hines [posts](https://x.com/BoHines/status/1631338997971656716) a video announcing that he is the CEO of Today is America.

20.41131   Also on 2 March 2023, Today is America [announces](https://x.com/TodayisAmerica/status/1631342854462218242) that "Today is America is proud to have acquired Students for Trump."

20.4114   On 23 October 2024, Bo Hines [authors](https://www.todayisamerica.com/article/students-for-trump-press-release) a press release for Students for Trump announcing that they are teaming up with Restore the Republic for a final push in the 2024 election.

20.41141   The press release [says](https://www.todayisamerica.com/article/students-for-trump-press-release) "Restore the Republic is a community-driven crypto project on the Solana blockchain focused on promoting civic engagement, protecting American values, and supporting efforts to educate the electorate about the importance of informed participation in our democracy."

20.4115   In August of 2024, Eric Trump [tweeted](https://x.com/EricTrump/status/1820906993802211751): "I have truly fallen in love with Crypto / Defi. Stay tuned for a big announcement...@Trump @realDonaldTrump @DonaldJTrumpJr"

20.41151   On 8 August 2024, Ryan Fournier \[tweets]9[https://web.archive.org/web/20260515164337/https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2024/08/08/a-trump-themed-token-soars-then-dives-95-after-his-son-dashes-hope-the-former-president-backed-it](https://web.archive.org/web/20260515164337/https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2024/08/08/a-trump-themed-token-soars-then-dives-95-after-his-son-dashes-hope-the-former-president-backed-it)): "Hearing word that @RestoretheRep is the official trump coin. Shot to 100 million market cap in an hour. wow. $RTR"

20.41152   Also on 8 August 2024, Eric Trump quote tweets Fournier's tweet and [says](https://x.com/EricTrump/status/1821606887806406671): "This is absolutely false"

20.41153   Ryan Fournier [tweets](https://x.com/RyanAFournier/status/1821612171220136339): "I was told by sources that Don Jr. would be backing this token. That is why I said rumor-Im not a big crypto guy and I was not in any way involved in this project."

20.41154   bagzybagz1321 [tweets](https://web.archive.org/web/20260515164337/https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2024/08/08/a-trump-themed-token-soars-then-dives-95-after-his-son-dashes-hope-the-former-president-backed-it) about the launch: "Spent 6 years in this space building an impeccable reputation. Flew to meet with Don Jr to advise. They picked the launch date and time. Then hard rugged us 5 mins after we were told they were tweeting. Was one of the hottest launches ever prior to that. I am so sorry everyone"

20.41155   Lookonchain [tweets](https://x.com/lookonchain/status/1821618713873018939): "5 Insider Wallets Earned Over $4M on $RTR in Just 6 Hours! $RTR is a new #MEMEcoin created 6 hours ago. 5 wallets spent \~5,580 $SOL ($882K) to buy 104.64M $RTR the first time $RTR opened trading, and sold 92.77M $RTR for 31,994 $SOL ($5.05M), making 26,414 $SOL ($4.17M). These 5 wallets were all newly created today, withdrew funds from #Coinbase and #Bybit, and only bought $RTR, which is obviously insiders."

20.4116   “I jumped into the political arena at a young age,” he said. “I think that we were just a little bit frustrated with some of the archaic ways in which people advertise in that space.” [-Bo Hines, attributed by Jessice Matthews and Leo Schwartz, "Trump's senior crypto advisor donated $1M in campaign advertisements to top Trump Super PAC one week before election" *Fortune* 14 April 2025](https://archive.is/sV18I)

20.412   "Since taking his White House role, Hines is a non-acting partner at Nxum, and he says that the firm’s political work is now handled by the firm’s other two general partners, one of whom is his father." [-Jessica Matthews and Leo Schwartz, "Trump's senior crypto advisor donated $1M in campaign advertisements to top Trump super PAC one week before election" *Fortune* 14 April 2026](https://fortune.com/2025/04/14/trump-senior-crypto-advisor-donated-1m-campaign-advertisements-maga-super-pac-week-before-election/)

20.42   NXUM Group LLC [donates](https://docquery.fec.gov/pdf/521/202412059731740521/202412059731740521.pdf) $1 million to Make America Great Again Inc (Trump's PAC) on 29 October 2024.

20.421   Donald Trump wins re-election on 5 November 2024.

20.43   "Just one week before the 2024 presidential election, the growth investment firm Hines cofounded, Nxum Group, donated $1 million in pro-Trump campaign billboard advertisements to the $400 million Super PAC Make America Great Again Inc., according to Federal Election Commission filings. Hines, who confirmed he oversaw all of Nxum’s work in the political space, declined to provide more details about the donations and advertisements, saying only that his company helped on the 'marketing side.'" [-Jessica Matthews and Leo Schwartz, "Trump's senior crypto advisor donated $1M in campaign advertisements to top Trump super PAC one week before election" *Fortune* 14 April 2026](https://fortune.com/2025/04/14/trump-senior-crypto-advisor-donated-1m-campaign-advertisements-maga-super-pac-week-before-election/)

20.44   Hines had started Nxum, a small consulting firm, with his father and another partner, [Gary Dennis](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gary-dennis-25ba424) around 2022. Each owned one-third. He stepped back from day-to-day management of the company when he joined the administration in early 2025 but kept his ownership stake, his government ethics disclosures show.
[https://archive.is/nfiDU](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.441   Todd Hines founded H3 Sportsgear in 1995, and "quickly became the nation's leading retail headwear and accessories provider." [-Todd Hines biography on NXUM Capital Team page](https://web.archive.org/web/20250915083420/https://www.nxumcapital.com/team/todd-hines)

20.442   Hines then launched Wild Sports which became "the dominant retail supplier of licensed outdoor games and furniture, capturing over 80% market share in the tailgating and outdoor games sector." [-Todd Hines biography on NXUM Capital Team page](https://web.archive.org/web/20250915083420/https://www.nxumcapital.com/team/todd-hines)

20.443   "In 2020, Hines pursued his passion for high-end automobiles by founding Mulinaro Motorcars, a luxury auto dealership designed to redefine the consumer buying experience. The company generated $55 million in sales in its first year." [-Todd Hines biography on NXUM Capital Team page](https://web.archive.org/web/20250915083420/https://www.nxumcapital.com/team/todd-hines)

20.5   "Hines exchanged Signal messages showing that while he was in the White House, he took part in a group chat with his company partners, where he discussed legislative developments and relayed Genius Act talking points as his partners were communicating with Tether’s chief executive." [-Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.45   As of 17 September 2025, NXUM Capital's Chief Investment Officer was Nav Sing. "He has held senior positions at firms such as Goldman Sachs, PIMCO, and Guggenheim Partners, and has managed portfolios ranging from several billion dollars to over $200 billion." [-Nav Singh biography on NXUM Capital Team page](https://web.archive.org/web/20250917023457/https://www.nxumcapital.com/team/nav-singh)

20.451   The Wall Street Journal claims that Nav Singh was [formerly known](https://archive.is/nfiDU#selection-2657.179-2657.209) as Navnoor Kang.

20.4511   "A 2015 Pensions & Investments conference profile lists a speaker named Navnoor Kang: "co-head of investment grade corporate credit at Guggenheim Partners… Portfolio Management Associate at PIMCO and Goldman Sachs. B.A. in Economics from Columbia University, 2003. If an identical education and work history was not enough, a [Backstage acting profile](https://www.backstage.com/tal/navnoor-kang/) lists the full name Navnoor Singh Kang with a headshot that matches the man shown on NXUM's website (before NXUM deleted it).  In fact, the NXUM profile headshot is taken by a photographer who specializes in actor headshots." [-Cory Klippsten](https://x.com/CorySwan/status/2110770757022130661)

20.4512   *The Wall Street Journal* [reports](https://archive.is/12Dyc#selection-741.0-741.183): "Fired from Guggenheim in early 2013 for violating the firm’s policies on reporting entertainment expenses, Mr. Kang landed a senior role at the New York retirement fund a year later."

20.4513   Navnoor Singh Kang played ANF Officer 1 in the 2021 drama [*Sand and Snow*](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt7675140/) and Rubin Constantino in the 2019 drama [*Jacob's Honor 2*](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt7675140/)

20.4514   "In 2016, Kang was indicted by the U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of New York.  He had been Director of Fixed Income at the $207 billion New York State pension fund.  Brokers lavished him with cocaine, crack cocaine, prostitutes, a $17,400 Panerai watch, a $4,200 Hermès bracelet for a girlfriend, VIP concert tickets, and luxury ski vacations. In return, he steered over $2 billion in public pension money to their firms."

20.452   Navnoor Kang [was head of fixed income](https://archive.is/RxJfJ#selection-699.0-699.106) at the New York State Common Retirement Fund until early 2016.

20.4521   While in this position, U.S. prosecutors [allege](https://archive.is/RxJfJ#selection-721.16-721.300) "that salespeople lavished Mr. Kang with everything from prostitutes and cocaine to getaway weekends, including a ski trip to Utah, and a luxury watch in return for Mr. Kang directing trades their way."

20.453   In November 2017, Kang "appeared in federal court and pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit securities fraud and honest-services wires fraud, under a law that makes it a crime to deprive someone of 'the intangible right of honest services.'" [-Justin Baer, "Behind the Fall of a New York State Pension Fund Executive" *The Wall Street Journal* 8 November 2017](https://archive.is/RxJfJ#selection-699.108-699.325)

20.454   "Mr. Kang admitted in court that he received some of the perks described by prosecutors, including a Utah ski trip, a luxury watch, dinners and concert tickets. He has denied taking money for drugs and prostitutes." [-Justin Baer, "Former New York Pension-Fund Executive Sentenced to 21 Months in Prison" *The Wall Street Journal* 12 July 2018](https://archive.is/12Dyc#selection-827.0-827.213)

20.4541   "U.S. prosecutors had sought at a prison term of at least 10 years for Mr. Kang, arguing in a filing earlier this year that the punishment was “warranted in this matter in light of Mr. Kang’s egregious conduct, his flagrant abuse of his position of public trust, and his pervasive obstruction of justice."  [-Justin Baer, "Former New York Pension-Fund Executive Sentenced to 21 Months in Prison" *The Wall Street Journal* 12 July 2018](https://archive.is/12Dyc#selection-831.0-834.0)

20.4542   Navnoor Kang was [sentenced](https://archive.is/12Dyc) to 21 months in prison.

20.4543   “I ask the court to give me the opportunity to rebuild my life,” Mr. Kang said. [-Justin Baer, "Former New York Pension-Fund Executive Sentenced to 21 Months in Prison" *The Wall Street Journal* 12 July 2018](https://archive.is/12Dyc#selection-733.0-733.79)

20.5   "In April 2025, while Hines was leading the administration’s push for the Genius Act, his father and their Nxum co-owner, Dennis, traveled to New York to meet Ardoino, the Tether chief, at a hotel near Central Park, according to a person who attended the meeting." [-Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.51   A person named Peter Vincer [set up](https://archive.is/nfiDU#selection-2807.0-2807.116) the meeting, according to The Wall Street Journal.

20.511   On 22 December 2024, the day Trump announces Hines appointment as crypto advisor, Peter Vincer [tweets](https://x.com/PeterVincer/status/1871051502737051717): "Dont underestimate Bo Hines. Look what he pulled off already!!"

20.512   [Peter Vincer](https://x.com/PeterVincer) founder of [Notorious LLC](https://notorious.llc/), "A Swiss army knife for brands, companies, and personalities alike."

20.513   "Vincer after the meeting sent Ardoino a “Tether Comprehensive Brand Plan,” that said Nxum would lead a “strategic lobbying and a full scale public relations and media awareness campaign” for Tether, according to a copy of the draft plan reviewed by the Journal." [-Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.514   "Tether agreed to pay Vincer’s company $415,000 a month, in six-month installments, for a minimum of two years. Tether sent its first $2.49 million payment on May 11, 2025, according to messages and blockchain payment records."

20.5141   On May 11, 2025, 0x77134cbC06cB00b66F4c7e623D5fdBF6777635EC, an address labeled as “Bitfinex: Hot Wallet” on Etherscan, sent $2.49 million in USDT to 0x4b3e4956a5Bf253Cf28f8cf9b9F71BfD100E98Fd across two transactions, with the $1 test transaction actually occurring the day before. [-"Tether paid Bo Hines' company while he was at White House, WSJ" *Protos* 15 October 2026](https://protos.com/tether-paid-bo-hines-company-while-he-was-at-white-house-wsj/)

20.5142   Following [this](https://protos.com/tether-paid-bo-hines-company-while-he-was-at-white-house-wsj/), all but $498,000 was transferred to 0xA6078664175FCfb093989EC778C03FAe58170814.

20.515   "Tether sent subsequent payments—which occurred after Bo Hines had left the White House—directly to Nxum. Blockchain records show Nxum-controlled wallets received two $2.49 million USDT payments directly from Bitfinex, in December 2025 and April 2026. The Nxum-controlled wallets sent a portion of each payment to Vincer and broke up the remaining amount three ways." [-Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.516   "Vincer told the Journal he served as an intermediary for Nxum’s deal with Tether. He transferred the contract directly to Nxum after Bo Hines left the administration." [-Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.517   "Everyone has agreed that you are never to be f--ed." [-Bo Hines, in a Signal message to Peter Vincer, according to Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.5171   Peter Vincer's Notorious LLC site [lists](https://notorious.llc/) USAT in a section titled "Trusted by - Clients & collaborators - Current partners, and a partial roll of former major clients. Many of our most significant engagements stay private."

20.5172   "In August 2026, Nxum offered Vincer $311,000 plus 21% of a coming Tether payment if he agreed never to discuss his dealings with Nxum, Tether, Dennis, or Todd or Bo Hines, according to a copy of the agreement. He said he didn’t sign." [-Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.518   "Around the same time, after the Journal began questioning people in Nxum’s orbit, Dennis accused Vincer of telling 'lies' to the press about their business agreement. 'Mistake,' Dennis texted him." [-Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.52   "According to an investor presentation reviewed by the Journal, Nxum had circulated plans under which Tether would acquire a 25% stake in the consulting firm for $56 million." [-Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.521   "Nxum has continued to expand its relationship with Tether. In recent months, it has begun circulating a pitch deck to potential investors that says Tether, the “anchor investor,” will buy a 25% stake in Nxum for $56 million. Nxum, which is offering to sell 10% to other investors, says it is the “strategic media infrastructure layer behind Tether” and says the founders will keep 65% of the company."

20.522   "A Nxum representative said that when Hines was working in the White House, he wasn’t aware that Nxum had business dealings with Tether and wasn’t involved in them. The representative said Hines “did not receive any Tether-derived funds during that period, and had no economic relationship of any kind with Tether while serving in the White House,” and that he didn’t engineer an arrangement for a position at Tether." [-Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.6   Nxum has also remained active in politics, helping launch in September 2025 the pro-crypto Fellowship PAC, which is chaired by Spiro, Tether’s head of government affairs. The organization has raised at least $11 million from Cantor Fitzgerald and others, according to federal disclosures. The PAC has paid more than $6.5 million to Nxum for issue advocacy advertising, among other services, the disclosures show. [-Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.61   Dennis messaged an associate as they were preparing a marketing campaign before the PAC was announced. The PAC’s ties to Tether and Nxum weren’t to be advertised. “Again, no link to Tether, Nxum, Bo,” he wrote. [-Sam Kessler, "He Crafted a Crypto Law for Trump - as His Company Got Millions from a Crypto Giant" *The Wall Street Journal* 14 October 2026](https://archive.is/nfiDU)

20.62   The Fellowship PAC is [created](https://docquery.fec.gov/pdf/436/202508079789412436/202508079789412436.pdf) on 07 August 2025.

20.621   Under "Name of Any Connected Organization, Affiliated Committee, Joint Fundraising Representative, or Leadership PAC Sponsor" they [list](https://docquery.fec.gov/pdf/436/202508079789412436/202508079789412436.pdf) "NONE"

20.622   The Fellowship PAC's [treasurer](https://docquery.fec.gov/pdf/436/202508079789412436/202508079789412436.pdf) is Mitchell Nobel.

20.6221   Marcus Evans Global Financial Markets Intelligence conference on Digital Asset Risk Management and Operations [lists](https://www.marcusevans.com/conferences/digitalassetrisk) Mitchell Nobel as Director of Digital Asset Strategy and Policy at Cantor Fitzgerald.

20.63   The Fellowship PAC [publishes](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/the-fellowship-pac-launches-with-over-100-million-committed-to-protect-americas-leadership-in-innovation-and-transparency-302556687.html) a press release that says "The Fellowship PAC, a new independent-expenditure PAC, today announced over $100 million commitment to back pro-innovation, pro-crypto candidates who will safeguard America's role as the global leader in digital assets and entrepreneurship."

20.631   "It’s worth noting, however, that the Fellowship PAC has only filed its registration paperwork so far. The gap between pledged money and official reports leaves questions about how much cash the PAC has actually banked." [-Vince Dioquino, "Fellowship PAC Launches with $100M to Advance Crypto Policy Goals" *Decrypt* 16 September 2025](https://decrypt.co/339641/fellowship-pac-100m-crypto-policy-goals)

20.6311   On 16 September 2025, their website [consists](https://web.archive.org/web/20250916193801/https://thefellowshippac.com/) solely of a contact form and a copyright.

20.6312   Their email [is listed](https://web.archive.org/web/20250916193801/https://thefellowshippac.com/) as [thefellowshippac@gmail.com](mailto:thefellowshippac@gmail.com)

20.6313   The Fellowship PAC [reported](https://docquery.fec.gov/pdf/734/202601309795180734/202601309795180734.pdf) spending $0 and receiving $0 in 2025.

20.64   Cantor Fitzgerald [donates](https://docquery.fec.gov/pdf/550/202604159857299550/202604159857299550.pdf) $10 million to the Fellowship PAC.

20.65   Fellowship PAC [pays](https://docquery.fec.gov/pdf/550/202604159857299550/202604159857299550.pdf) NXUM Group LLC $1 million on 21 January 2026.

20.651   Fellowship PAC [pays](https://docquery.fec.gov/pdf/550/202604159857299550/202604159857299550.pdf) NXUM Group LLC $2 million on 26 January 2026.

20.652   On 7 April 2026, Fellowship PAC [spends](https://election.org/political-ad/fellowship-pac-supports-clay-fuller-2026-04-06-0mh9651) $300,000 in support of Clay Fuller, candidate for U.S. House - Georgia District 14.

20.6521   The [payee](https://election.org/political-ad/fellowship-pac-supports-clay-fuller-2026-04-06-0mh9651) is NXUM Group LLC for advertising services.

20.66   Tether [names](https://www.theblock.co/news/ecosystems/2026-04-01-crypto-super-pac-names-tether-exec-chairman-as-stablecoin-debate-in-d-c-intensifies-396081) Jesse Spiro, Tether US VP of Regulatory Affairs, as chairman of the PAC.

20.67   On 12 January 2026, Anchor Labs Inc [donates](https://docquery.fec.gov/pdf/550/202604159857299550/202604159857299550.pdf) $1 million to the Fellowship PAC.

20.671   "Anchorage Digital" refers to the services that are offered through the wholly-owned subsidiaries of Anchor Labs, Inc., a Delaware corporation." [https://www.anchorage.com/legal](https://www.anchorage.com/legal)

20.6711   On 15 September 2025, Anchorage Digital [published](https://www.anchorage.com/press-room/tether-selects-anchorage-digital-set-new-standard-u-s-stablecoins) this press release "Tether Selects Anchorage Digital to Set New Standard for U.S. Stablecoins" announcing that "Together \[with Tether], we are launching a new, GENIUS Act-compliant stablecoin for the U.S. marketplace, USA₮—issued from Anchorage Digital Bank NA, the first and only U.S. federally chartered digital asset bank.

20.6712   On 11 March 2025, Cantor Fitzgerald [partnered](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/cantor-fitzgerald-partners-with-digital-asset-custodians-anchorage-digital-and-copperco-to-support-bitcoin-financing-business-302397938.html) with Anchorage Digital to "support Bitcoin financing business."

20.67121   Cantor Fitzgerald [says](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/cantor-fitzgerald-partners-with-digital-asset-custodians-anchorage-digital-and-copperco-to-support-bitcoin-financing-business-302397938.html) Anchorage Digital and Cooper.co will "serve as collateral managers and custodians for the firm's new global Bitcoin financing business, which will provide leverage to institutional investors who hold Bitcoin.

20.672   "The issuer of USA₮ is Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A., America’s first federally regulated stablecoin issuer." [-Tether Announces the Launch of USAT, the Federally Regulated, Dollar-Backed Stablecoin, Made in America, 27 January 2026](https://tether.io/news/tether-announces-the-launch-of-usat-the-federally-regulated-dollar-backed-stablecoin-made-in-america/)

20.673   In February 2026, Tether [announces](https://tether.io/news/tether-announces-100-million-strategic-equity-investment-in-anchorage-digital/?trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block) a $100 million "strategic equity investment" in Anchorage Digital.

20.7   On 12 September, Tether [unveils](https://tether.io/news/tether-unveils-usat-its-planned-u-s-regulated-dollar-backed-stablecoin-and-will-appoint-bo-hines-as-ceo-of-tether-usat/) planned U.S.-regulated, dollar backed stablecoin USAT.

20.71   Bo Hines [is appointed](https://tether.io/news/tether-unveils-usat-its-planned-u-s-regulated-dollar-backed-stablecoin-and-will-appoint-bo-hines-as-ceo-of-tether-usat/) as Tether USAT's "future Chief Executive Officer."

20.711   16 days earlier Tether [mints](https://x.com/lookonchain/status/1960740824729444630) 1 billion tether tokens in one day.

20.712   24 days earlier, Tether [appoints](https://tether.io/news/tether-appoints-former-white-house-crypto-council-executive-director-bo-hines-as-strategic-advisor-for-digital-assets-and-u-s-strategy/) Bo Hines as Strategic Advisor for Digital Assets and US Strategy.

20.7121   "Well, look, you know, I've stepped down from my roles touching anything related to crypto in the White House, and you know, I felt like this was a fantastic opportunity to jump into the private sector and do exactly what the Genius Act intended to do, which was unsure the best developed in the space on shore, the brightest minds in." [-Bo Hines](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-bloomberg-talks-116249773/episode/tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino-tether-usa-ceo-bo-hines-talk-stablecoin-294739882/)

20.7122   "Hines, who most recently served as Executive Director of the White House Crypto Council under President Donald Trump, will start with immediate effect to directly engage and coordinate Tether’s U.S. strategy and expansion as part of the Group’s core team." [-Tether press release](https://tether.io/news/tether-appoints-former-white-house-crypto-council-executive-director-bo-hines-as-strategic-advisor-for-digital-assets-and-u-s-strategy/)

20.713   34 days earlier, Bo Hines [tweets](https://x.com/BoHines/status/1954281417158066392) "As I return to the private sector, I look forward to continuing my support for the crypto ecosystem as it thrives here in the United States."

20.7131   "Well, look, you know I had been in conversations with everyone in the industry over the course of the last eight months as we worked diligently on Genius to make sure it was the best product for the American people. And you know, it took my job very seriously in that way. We wanted diversity of thought. We wanted to hear from the entire ecosystem before we developed the product that would upend the financial system in a positive way." [Bo Hines](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-bloomberg-talks-116249773/episode/tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino-tether-usa-ceo-bo-hines-talk-stablecoin-294739882/)

20.7132   "And then obviously we got into August resigned for my role. I had several interviews in which I said I was courting I was being courted by several different firms and receiving many different offers. I went through those offers and talked about those with my family and then decided this was the best place for me to build." [Bo Hines](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-bloomberg-talks-116249773/episode/tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino-tether-usa-ceo-bo-hines-talk-stablecoin-294739882/)

20.714   "On behalf of the Company, we are all thrilled at his decision to join our Organization and to contribute to building our Once in a Century Company. Welcome Bo 🦾❤️" [-Paolo Ardoino](https://x.com/paoloardoino/status/1957752801330700507)

20.715   "Thrilled to join @tether! Huge thanks to @paoloardoino & the team for the warm welcome. Excited to help build an ecosystem of digital asset products that set the standard for compliance & innovation—empowering U.S. consumers and reshaping our financial system. The best is yet to come." [-Bo Hines](https://x.com/BoHines/status/1957759591619416511)

20.716   "Asked why he joined Tether, Hines cited the company’s role as a major purchaser of U.S. Treasuries: 'What they’re doing for the U.S. government is extremely important, just from a public‑private perspective,' Hines said. 'They are one of the largest purchasers of U.S. debt, which helps ensure we retain more control over our own economy.'" [-Jason Brett, "Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino And Advisor Bo Hines Discuss U.S. Stablecoins" *Forbes* 26 August 2025](https://archive.is/1QJjY)

20.7161   "Ardoino said the decision to bring Hines on board reflected respect for his ability to deliver complex legislation across party lines: 'When I heard Bo decided to move on from his government job, I was impressed by his ability to drive the GENIUS Act forward and position the U.S. to seize this opportunity,' said Ardoino." [-Jason Brett, "Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino And Advisor Bo Hines Discuss U.S. Stablecoins" *Forbes* 26 August 2025](https://archive.is/1QJjY)

20.72   On 27 January 2026, Tether [announces](https://tether.io/news/tether-announces-the-launch-of-usat-the-federally-regulated-dollar-backed-stablecoin-made-in-america/) the launch of USAT, "a federally regulated, dollar-backed stablecoin specifically to operate within the United States' new federal stablecoin framework established under the GENIUS Act."

20.721   "USA₮ is issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, and is available to institutions and platforms alike.  USA₮ has been designed to operate within the GENIUS Act’s new federal stablecoin framework. U.S.-regulated exchanges and banking partners are being lined up to support broad access to USA₮ across the American financial ecosystem. Cantor Fitzgerald serves as the designated reserve custodian and preferred primary dealer, ensuring secure asset management and clear visibility into reserves from day one." [-Tether press release](https://tether.io/news/tether-announces-the-launch-of-usat-the-federally-regulated-dollar-backed-stablecoin-made-in-america/)

20.722   “Our focus is stability, transparency, and responsible governance, ensuring that the United States continues to lead in dollar innovation.” [-Bo Hines, CEO of Tether USAT](https://tether.io/news/tether-announces-the-launch-of-usat-the-federally-regulated-dollar-backed-stablecoin-made-in-america/)

20.723   "So we have expressly said a few times now that also USDT will be compliant with the Genius Act under the Foreign Issuer Protocol and there is a pathway in the GENIUS Act to make happen, and that's what that is focusing on. But at the same time, we felt the need to create a domestic stable coin in United States that is focusing on the actual needs of the US market. It is a very efficient market compared to all the emerging market developing countries, where USDT is leading the way into financial inclusion and growth and banking. The bank or the under bed. But while in the United States the landscape is different." [-Paolo Ardoino](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-bloomberg-talks-116249773/episode/tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino-tether-usa-ceo-bo-hines-talk-stablecoin-294739882/)

20.73   As of 3 November 2026, USAT [reports](https://usat.io/news/usat-reports-176-9-million-in-reserves-with-90-in-treasury-backed-assets/) $176.9 million in reserves, with 90% in treasury-backed assets.

20.74   On 18 November 2026, USAT [announces](https://usat.io/news/usat-expands-to-avalanche-broadening-access-to-regulated-digital-dollars/) that it is now live on Avalanche.

20.75   "And so you know, when I announced that I was resigning, I had received countless first from different firms. And again I'll point back to my prior comment. When I was looking at different opportunities, I said, well, hey, look, I have an opportunity now to do something that you know, I described as being extremely important when I was in my role, and that was on shore the most important players in the space." [-Bo Hines](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-bloomberg-talks-116249773/episode/tether-ceo-paolo-ardoino-tether-usa-ceo-bo-hines-talk-stablecoin-294739882/)

20.751   "For the Hustle. For the Home. For You." [https://usat.io](https://usat.io)

20.76   On 12 September 2025, [had agreed](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2070457/000121390025087358/ea024779504ex99-3_twenty.htm) to join the board of Bitcoin treasury company, Twenty One Capital.

20.761   Bo Hines is [announced](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2070457/000121390026037460/ea0280065-10k_twenty.htm) as a Director on the Board of Directors for Twenty One Capital.

items.title: Acemoglu Wants Pro-Worker AIs (FT, Daron Acemoglu)
items.text:
*Gimme some of that "pro-worker AI", sir!*

![](https://m.stacker.news/168066)

The [economist who forgot economics](https://www.econlib.org/the-economist-who-forgot-economics) is out here talking, if not bullshit than at *least* some sort of shit. 

> The impressive victory of Democrats in the midterms is a lifeline for US democracy. But the challenges ahead are formidable. Democrats remain divided, with so-called progressives and moderates increasingly critical of each other.  **The standard narrative here misses the big picture.**

OK, cool; enlighten us, oh you shiny Nobel Prize-winning elite economist.

Apparently, the story goes that *moderate* Democrats are more economically literate, while it's the progressives who mess about with radical nonsense ideas.

## "alas, the ideas that progressives advocate are no match for the transformations impacting our economy. Rather than being too bold, progressives, also, are too timid."

**4 types of progressive policies we need**

1. "**Ensuring affordability**": yeah, amazing.

> such as city-owned grocery stores or free bus services in New York. Slightly lower grocery bills will not change the fact that about half the US population has seen very little gain in their (pre-tax) real incomes since around 1980.

oh yeah, PREACH! https://stacker.news/items/1608876 https://stacker.news/items/1599758

2. **"policies to push for higher wages" oh great**
   Force companies to share AI profits with workers (yes, they do; it's called equity compensation, of which there has been a ton https://stacker.news/items/1619212; or just generally *wages*, https://stacker.news/items/1457057, https://stacker.news/items/1601547, so what's your point?)

> If AI continues to go in the direction of automation, any policy that increases wages would only further motivate employers to automate more — since incentives to do so are proportional to the labour costs that companies would save.

Sure yeah, that's a pickle.

3. **"some progressives have proposed pausing frontier AI or halting data centre construction."**

Have fun with that. *Life finds a way,* and also, NIMBY has never achieved anything good in human history, has it?

4. **"we could try to deal with inequality by increasing taxes and redistribution."**

Sure yeah, cool, that's a *great* way to go about things. Moar cowbell, gimme gimme gimme extra gov violence!!

> Ideas based on universal basic income (UBI) are particularly popular among some progressives. But UBI is defeatist, giving up on the aspiration to build a society in which people can use their talents. It is also likely to create a two-tiered world in which those who control AI will have huge incomes and prestige, even if they pay high taxes. Those living off UBI would be viewed as “takers”, with much less social status.

I dunno... would UBI takers be *more* or *less* stigmatized than welfare takers? https://stacker.news/items/1593954, https://stacker.news/items/1603158, https://stacker.news/items/1602493 **what about the boomers??**

## "Fortunately, something more radical is available. We are just not discussing it at the moment"

AMAZING, let's go!

* AI might complement workers, making them more productive and richer (https://stacker.news/items/1618797)
* "Human cognition is clearly multimodal" OK fine, AI-written warning on that one. "AI models, meanwhile, excel at the things that humans cannot do." ish.

> If two things are different, the most natural way of using them is in a complementary way. So it should be with AI and humans. But here is the snag. Captivated by dreams of superintelligence, the industry is not pursuing this and, left to its own devices, it won’t. Progressive policy should recognise this reality and build institutions and norms to encourage pro-worker AI.

This bit I don't *quite* understand. **HOW?!**

> If an automation technology and humans have the same cost of performing a task, the current US tax code gives the company choosing automation a 20-25 per cent cost advantage. In principle, this is easy to fix. We can tax all income at the same rate, regardless of whether it is (often arbitrarily) labelled labour income or capital income.

Fine, sounds cool. I'm game.

...and then the article just fiddles out. Cool. **what tha hell is pro-worker AIs?!**

> Pro-worker AI is more radical than the policies progressives usually focus on. It asks us to do new things for a new age. This is the best kind of radicalism because it aims to help workers and it is feasible. What’s more, it may provide the best means of revitalising our crisis-ridden liberal democracy.

***

items.title: Bills Tiptoe by the Chiefs 13 -10: My Three Takeways
items.text:
Wow this is a game Buffalo usually loses but not tonight! Here are my three takeaways:

1. Short out to the Bills special teams. They were the difference in the game tonight. Tyler Bass hit FGs from 54 and 57 with the 57 being the game winning walk off kick. The punter Jake had a really good day. Pinning the Chiefs deep in their own territory was great in a game where the weather was so ugly. Then Buffalo Joe getting a tip on the punt and Dorch picking the ball up and getting 15 years was all great plays. They didn’t take any penalties on special teams. This unit was clearly better than KC’s and that was the difference in the game. 

2. Josh Allen was awful this game. Brady rode Cook all game long. 30 carries over 100 yards. With the weather being poor I don’t have an issue with Brady’s gameplay but when Spags started to dial up the blitz Brady and Josh had no answers. DJ and Kincaid were non factors. It would be easy to blame the weather but Mahomes was able to complete balls to Travis. This is what keeps me from saying that Josh Allen is the best QB in football. Throwing INTS in the red zone and just coming up with terrible games like this is why we haven’t won big yet. I hate to beat up the offense too much on a great win but we need more from Brady and Josh in big games like this. But I must say if Sean McDermott was coaching we probably lose this game. 

3. The refs were terrible tonight. They missed a lot of calls. It felt like they were trying to give the game to buffalo. The Rice call was a huge overturn. I thought he caught it but the booth replay overturned it. Just flags on top of flags. Travis was called for a meh pass interference and a meh holding call on Dawson Knox. Just wasn’t happen with the calls. We need the players  to determine these games not the refs. Now I see why folks started to hate the Chiefs normally THEY would get all of these calls.  But besides the refs the Bills defense did their job. Having Hooker is making an impact and I think the players are buying into Jim’s system. Overall I am happy with the Defense. 

This was a  tough game I am happy buffalo pulled it off. And now we have a 54% chance to get the one seed. Normally Bills Vs. Chiefs is our super bowl and then we have a let down. Hopefully with Brady that doesn’t happen.  Next week we get our revenge against New England
